tools.name: get_docs
tools.description: Read a TgPay Merchant API integration doc. START HERE before integrating: topics quickstart, invoices, subscriptions, transfers-checks, webhooks, errors.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Start token issuance WITHOUT the Mini App UI: creates a merchant-app request and returns a t.me approve link plus a poll_secret. Show the link to the human — they approve with one button in the @tgpaycryptobot bot — then call connect_status with the poll_secret. Use only when no API token is configu

tools.name: connect_status
tools.description: Poll a connect request. Returns pending | denied | expired, or — once approved — the app id and the API TOKEN (returned exactly once: save it to the project's .env immediately, never print it in logs). The token is SCOPED (read, invoices, subscriptions, webhooks) — it cannot move money out of the ap

tools.name: getMe
tools.description: Verify the token: app id, name, webhook config, token scopes.

tools.name: getBalance
tools.description: Merchant app balance per asset (available + onhold).

tools.name: getCurrencies
tools.description: Supported crypto assets (code/name/decimals) and fiats.

tools.name: getExchangeRates
tools.description: Current asset↔fiat display rates.

tools.name: getStats
tools.description: App volume/count stats for a period.

tools.name: getInvoices
tools.description: List invoices (newest first).

tools.name: getChecks
tools.description: List checks.

tools.name: getTransfers
tools.description: List app→user transfers.

tools.name: getSubscriptionPlans
tools.description: List subscription plans.

tools.name: getSubscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions (subscribers).

tools.name: createInvoice
tools.description: Create a one-off payment invoice; the payer opens result.mini_app_invoice_url. See the invoices doc.

tools.name: deleteInvoice
tools.description: Delete an unpaid invoice.

tools.name: refundInvoice
tools.description: Refund a paid invoice (moves money app→payer; partial refunds accumulate up to the face amount).

tools.name: createCheck
tools.description: Create a bearer payout link (moves money to a hold).

tools.name: deleteCheck
tools.description: Delete an unclaimed check (refunds the hold).

tools.name: transfer
tools.description: Pay a Telegram user from the app balance (instant, irreversible). MONEY MOVES — double-check user_id and amount; spend_id is the idempotency key.

tools.name: transferBatch
tools.description: Batch of transfers; items succeed/fail independently. MONEY MOVES.

tools.name: createSubscriptionPlan
tools.description: Create an IMMUTABLE recurring-billing plan; send payers to result.mini_app_subscribe_url. See the subscriptions doc.

tools.name: archiveSubscriptionPlan
tools.description: Stop new signups for a plan (live subscriptions keep renewing).

tools.name: cancelSubscription
tools.description: Stop future charges for one subscription (paid time runs out).

tools.name: updateApp
tools.description: Update app name / webhook_url (https) / webhook_events opt-in list. Needs the 'webhooks' scope (the connect-issued token has it) or the primary token. See the webhooks doc for the event types and signature verification.
